blocks.text: Kelajak haqida gapirish uchun ingliz tilida faqat **will** emas. Agar voqea **hozirning o'zida aniq** bo'lsa — kelishib qo'yilgan yoki jadvalga yozilgan — hozirgi zamonlar ishlatiladi. Asoslari qizil kitobda (→ qizil kitob, 25-dars). O'zbek tilida ham shunday: «Ertaga Samarqandga **ketyapman**», «Poyezd soat yettida **jo'naydi**» — shakli hozirgi zamon, ma'nosi kelajak. Shuning uchun o'zbeklarga g'oya tanish; qiyini — ikkita hozirgi zamondan to'g'risini tanlash.

**am / is / are + -ing** — biz allaqachon **qaror qilib, tashkil qilib qo'ygan** reja: chipta olingan, uchrashuv belgilangan, boshqa odam bilan kelishilgan. Bunday gapda kelajak vaqti ko'pincha aytiladi (tomorrow, on Friday, next week) yoki vaziyatdan aniq. O'zbekcha «**-yapman**» ning kelajak ma'nosi bilan bir xil: I**'m seeing** the doctor tomorrow — Ertaga shifokorga **boryapman**. Biz boshqara olmaydigan narsalar (ob-havo, taxmin) uchun Present Continuous ishlatilmaydi: «It's raining tomorrow» deyilmaydi.

items.text: Kate **is flying** to Bukhara on Monday.

blocks.text: **Present Simple** — voqea **rasmiy jadval yoki dastur** bo'yicha bo'ladi: transport, kino va teatr, darslar, imtihonlar, do'konlar, konferensiyalar. Bu yerda reja shaxsiy emas — u hamma uchun belgilangan: The train **leaves** at 7.30; The course **starts** on 1 October. Odamlar haqida ham, agar rejasi jadvalga o'xshash qat'iy bo'lsa, Present Simple mumkin: I **start** my new job on Monday (I'm starting ham to'g'ri). Lekin oddiy shaxsiy kelishuv uchun — faqat Continuous: «I meet Kate tonight» emas, I**'m meeting** Kate tonight.

rows: I**'m going** to London on Friday.
We**'re having** a party on Saturday.
She**'s taking** her exam next week.

blocks.text: **going to** (→ 20-dars) — **niyat**: qaror qilingan, lekin hali tashkil qilinmagan bo'lishi mumkin. I**'m going to** look for a new job (qaror bor) — I**'m starting** a new job on Monday (hammasi kelishilgan). Kelishilgan rejalarda ikkalasi ham ko'pincha to'g'ri: I**'m meeting** / I**'m going to meet** Tom tonight. Taxmin va ob-havo uchun esa — going to yoki will, hozirgi zamon emas (→ 22–23-darslar).

rows: I**'m seeing** the dentist on Friday.
I**'m going to** change my dentist.
It**'ll rain** / It**'s going to** rain tomorrow.

blocks.text: Savollar: What are you doing ...? / What time does ...?

Kimningdir **rejasi** haqida — Present Continuous: What **are** you **doing** at the weekend? When **are** you **leaving**? **Jadval** haqida — Present Simple: What time **does** the bus **leave**? When **does** the term **start**? Diqqat: **What do you do?** — kasbni so'raydi («Kim bo'lib ishlaysiz?»), kelajakdagi rejani emas.

items.text: What **are** you **doing** on Saturday? — **I'm helping** my brother move.
items.translation: Shanba kuni nima **qilyapsan**? — Akamga ko'chishda **yordam beryapman**.

items.text: When **does** the new semester **start**? — On the 2nd of September.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «I meet my friends tomorrow» → I**'m meeting** my friends tomorrow; «What do you do tonight?» → What **are** you **doing** tonight?; «It's raining tomorrow» → It**'s going to** rain / It **will** rain; «I will go to Samarkand tomorrow — I've got the ticket» → I**'m going** to Samarkand tomorrow (reja kelishilgan); «What time is the train leaving tomorrow?» — mumkin, lekin jadval uchun tabiiyrog'i: What time **does** the train **leave**?

Kundalik testi: reja **sizning** (yoki do'stingizning) kundaligingizga yozilgan bo'lsa — Present Continuous. U **rasmiy jadvalda** (vokzal tablosi, kino afishasi, dars jadvali) bo'lsa — Present Simple.

items: **Present Continuous** — kelishilgan shaxsiy reja: We**'re flying** to London on Friday.
**Present Simple** — jadval va dastur: The flight **leaves** at 6.40.
**going to** — niyat (→ 20-dars): I**'m going to** learn to drive.
Ob-havo va taxmin — hozirgi zamon emas: It**'s going to** snow.

examples.title: Fixed plans: **we're flying** to London on Friday
examples.description: Kelishilgan, tashkil qilingan reja (chipta olingan, uchrashuv belgilangan) — Present Continuous. O'zbekchada ham «-yapman»: ertaga ketyapman.

sentences.text: We**'re flying** to London on Friday — the tickets arrived yesterday.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni Londonga **uchib ketyapmiz** — chiptalar kecha keldi.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **is having** an operation on her knee next Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Dilnoza kelasi seshanba tizzasidan **operatsiya qilinyapti**.

sentences.text: **I'm meeting** the new client at ten, so I can't take the kids to school.
sentences.translation: Soat o'nda yangi mijoz bilan **uchrashyapman**, shuning uchun bolalarni maktabga olib bora olmayman.

sentences.text: Tomorrow evening Aziz and Madina **are coming** round for dinner.
sentences.translation: Ertaga kechqurun Aziz va Madina kechki ovqatga **kelishyapti**.

sentences.text: My sister **is getting** married in June, and the whole family is helping.
sentences.translation: Singlim iyunda **turmushga chiqyapti**, butun oila yordam beryapti.

sentences.text: Oliver **is starting** his new job at the bank on the first of March.
sentences.translation: Oliver birinchi martda bankdagi yangi ishini **boshlayapti**.

sentences.text: After the conference, we**'re having** dinner with the investors at a restaurant in Oxford.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyadan keyin Oksforddagi restoranda investorlar bilan **kechki ovqat qilyapmiz**.

sentences.text: Next weekend Jasur **is taking** his parents to the mountains for their anniversary.
sentences.translation: Kelasi dam olish kunlari Jasur ota-onasini to'y yilligi munosabati bilan toqqa **olib boryapti**.

sentences.text: The builders **are coming** on Monday to fix the roof, finally!
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar dushanba kuni tomni tuzatgani **kelishyapti**, nihoyat!

sentences.text: Sorry, Kate, I can't help on Saturday — **I'm working** all day.
sentences.translation: Kechir, Keyt, shanba kuni yordam bera olmayman — kun bo'yi **ishlayman**.

examples.title: Plans: **What are you doing** ...? / **I'm not going**
examples.description: Rejalarni so'rash — What are you doing tonight / at the weekend? Inkor — rejada yo'q: we aren't going, he isn't playing.

sentences.text: **What are** you **doing** this weekend? — Nothing special, just relaxing at home.
sentences.translation: Bu dam olish kunlari nima **qilyapsiz**? — Hech narsa, uyda dam olaman.

sentences.text: **Are** you **coming** to Bekzod's birthday party on Thursday?
sentences.translation: Payshanba kuni Bekzodning tug'ilgan kuniga **kelyapsanmi**?

sentences.text: We **aren't going** away this summer because we're saving for a car.
sentences.translation: Bu yoz hech qayerga **ketmayapmiz**, chunki mashinaga pul yig'yapmiz.

sentences.text: **Is** Sarah **joining** us for lunch tomorrow, or is she too busy?
sentences.translation: Ertaga Sara biz bilan **tushlikka qo'shilyaptimi** yoki juda bandmi?

sentences.text: When **are** you **leaving** for Edinburgh? — Early on Sunday morning.
sentences.translation: Edinburgga **qachon jo'nayapsiz**? — Yakshanba kuni erta tongda.

sentences.text: **I'm not going** to the meeting this afternoon — my manager is going instead.
sentences.translation: Bugun tushdan keyingi majlisga **bormayapman** — o'rnimga menejerim boradi.

sentences.text: Who **is** Madina **meeting** at the airport tonight? — Her cousin from London.
sentences.translation: Madina bugun kechqurun aeroportda kimni **kutib olyapti**? — Londondagi amakivachchasini.

sentences.text: How **are** you **getting** to the wedding — by car or by train?
sentences.translation: To'yga qanday **boryapsiz** — mashinadami yoki poyezddami?

sentences.text: Tom **isn't playing** in the final on Saturday because of his injury.
sentences.translation: Tom jarohati tufayli shanba kungi finalda **o'ynamayapti**.

sentences.text: What **are** your parents **doing** for New Year? — They're staying with my aunt in Fergana.
sentences.translation: Ota-onangiz Yangi yilni qanday **o'tkazishyapti**? — Farg'onadagi xolamnikida qolishyapti.

examples.title: Timetables: the train **leaves**, the film **starts**
examples.description: Jadval va dastur bo'yicha bo'ladigan voqealar — transport, kino, darslar, do'konlar — Present Simple bilan: voqea kelajakda, lekin jadval hozir mavjud.

sentences.text: The last train to Samarkand **leaves** at 9.40 tonight.
sentences.translation: Samarqandga oxirgi poyezd bugun kechqurun soat 9:40 da **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: What time **does** the film **start**? — At half past seven, so we've got time for dinner.
sentences.translation: Film soat nechada **boshlanadi**? — Yetti yarimda, kechki ovqatga ulguramiz.

sentences.text: Our flight **lands** in Manchester at six in the morning, local time.
sentences.translation: Reysimiz Manchesterga mahalliy vaqt bilan ertalab soat oltida **qo'nadi**.

sentences.text: The museum **doesn't open** on Mondays, so let's go on Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Muzey dushanba kunlari **ochilmaydi**, seshanba boraylik.

sentences.text: Hurry up! The shop **closes** in twenty minutes.
sentences.translation: Shoshil! Do'kon yigirma daqiqadan keyin **yopiladi**.

sentences.text: When **does** the spring semester **begin** at your university?
sentences.translation: Universitetingizda bahorgi semestr qachon **boshlanadi**?

sentences.text: The concert **finishes** at eleven, and the metro **runs** until midnight.
sentences.translation: Konsert soat o'n birda **tugaydi**, metro esa yarim tungacha **qatnaydi**.

sentences.text: Tomorrow is a holiday, so the banks **don't open** until Wednesday.
sentences.translation: Ertaga bayram, shuning uchun banklar chorshanbagacha **ochilmaydi**.

sentences.text: **Does** the bus to the airport **stop** near your hotel?
sentences.translation: Aeroportga boradigan avtobus mehmonxonangiz yaqinida **to'xtaydimi**?

sentences.text: According to the timetable, the ferry **departs** at 8.15 and **arrives** at noon.
sentences.translation: Jadvalga ko'ra parom soat 8:15 da **jo'naydi** va tushda **yetib keladi**.

examples.title: My plan + the timetable: **I'm leaving** ... it **goes** ...
examples.description: Bir gapda ikkalasi: shaxsiy kelishilgan reja — Present Continuous, rasmiy jadval — Present Simple.

sentences.text: **I'm leaving** tomorrow morning — my train **goes** at 7.15.
sentences.translation: Ertaga ertalab **ketyapman** — poyezdim soat 7:15 da **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: We**'re going** to the theatre tonight; the play **starts** at seven.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun teatrga **boryapmiz**, spektakl soat yettida **boshlanadi**.

sentences.text: Emma **is flying** to Tashkent on Friday, and her plane **lands** just after midnight.
sentences.translation: Emma juma kuni Toshkentga **uchyapti**, samolyoti yarim tundan keyin **qo'nadi**.

sentences.text: What time **does** your train **leave**? — At ten, but **I'm meeting** Jasur at the station first.
sentences.translation: Poyezding soat nechada **jo'naydi**? — O'nda, lekin avval vokzalda Jasur bilan **uchrashyapman**.

sentences.text: Bekzod **is taking** an English course this summer — it **runs** from June to August.
sentences.translation: Bekzod bu yoz ingliz tili kursida **o'qiyapti** — kurs iyundan avgustgacha **davom etadi**.

sentences.text: The match **kicks off** at three, so **we're having** an early lunch.
sentences.translation: O'yin soat uchda **boshlanadi**, shuning uchun ertaroq **tushlik qilyapmiz**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **coming** with us? The bus **leaves** in ten minutes!
sentences.translation: Biz bilan **kelyapsanmi**? Avtobus o'n daqiqadan keyin **jo'naydi**!

sentences.text: Nilufar **is giving** a talk at the conference, which **opens** on Monday.
sentences.translation: Nilufar dushanba kuni **ochiladigan** konferensiyada **ma'ruza qilyapti**.

sentences.text: My parents **are visiting** us next week; their flight **gets in** at noon on Tuesday.
sentences.translation: Ota-onam kelasi hafta bizni **ko'rgani kelishyapti**; reyslari seshanba tushda **yetib keladi**.

sentences.text: Since the course **finishes** at five, **I'm picking** the kids up at half past.
sentences.translation: Kurs soat beshda **tugagani** uchun bolalarni besh yarimda **olib ketyapman**.

examples.title: Schedules and programmes: the course **starts** ...
examples.description: Rasmiy dastur: festival, kurs, imtihon, qonun, rasmiy tashrif — Present Simple. Qat'iy jadvalga ega shaxsiy rejada ham mumkin: I start my new job on Monday.

sentences.text: The festival **opens** on the 1st of September and **lasts** for a week.
sentences.translation: Festival 1-sentyabrda **ochiladi** va bir hafta **davom etadi**.

sentences.text: Our English exam **is** on the 15th, so we've got two weeks to revise.
sentences.translation: Ingliz tili imtihonimiz **15-sanada**, shuning uchun takrorlashga ikki haftamiz bor.

sentences.text: I **start** my new job on Monday, and I'm a bit nervous.
sentences.translation: Dushanba kuni yangi ishimni **boshlayman**, biroz hayajondaman.

sentences.text: Term **ends** on the 20th of December, and the children **go back** on the 10th of January.
sentences.translation: Chorak 20-dekabrda **tugaydi**, bolalar 10-yanvarda yana **maktabga qaytadi**.

sentences.text: The president **visits** Bukhara next week, according to the official programme.
sentences.translation: Rasmiy dasturga ko'ra prezident kelasi hafta Buxoroga **tashrif buyuradi**.

sentences.text: What day **does** the new tax law **come** into force?
sentences.translation: Yangi soliq qonuni qaysi kuni **kuchga kiradi**?

sentences.text: Tomorrow's lesson **begins** at nine sharp, so don't be late.
sentences.translation: Ertangi dars soat to'qqizda **boshlanadi**, kechikmang.

sentences.text: The new metro station **opens** to the public next spring.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro bekati kelasi bahorda hamma uchun **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: Sarah **finishes** her contract in May and then **returns** to Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Saraning shartnomasi mayda **tugaydi**, keyin u Edinburgga **qaytadi**.

sentences.text: **Does** the summer school **include** trips to Samarkand and Khiva?
sentences.translation: Yozgi maktab dasturiga Samarqand va Xivaga sayohatlar **kiradimi**?

examples.title: Arranged, intended or predicted?
examples.description: Kelishilgan reja — Present Continuous; niyat (qaror bor, hali tashkil qilinmagan) — going to; ob-havo va taxmin — Present Continuous emas, going to yoki will.

sentences.text: **I'm seeing** the dentist on Friday at four — I booked it last week.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni soat to'rtda tish shifokoriga **boraman** — o'tgan hafta yozilib qo'ydim.

sentences.text: Kate **is going to** find a new dentist — hers is always late.
sentences.translation: Keyt yangi tish shifokori **topmoqchi** — unikisi doim kechikadi.

sentences.text: Look at those clouds — it**'s going to** rain any minute.
sentences.translation: Anovi bulutlarga qara — hozir yomg'ir **yog'adi**.

sentences.text: The forecast says it **will be** sunny in Tashkent tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko'ra ertaga Toshkentda havo **quyoshli bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: We**'re moving** house on the 5th — the van is already booked.
sentences.translation: 5-sanada uy **ko'chyapmiz** — yuk mashinasi allaqachon buyurtma qilingan.

sentences.text: We**'re going to** move somewhere bigger one day, but we haven't decided where.
sentences.translation: Qachondir kattaroq joyga **ko'chmoqchimiz**, lekin qayerga ekanini hali hal qilmadik.

sentences.text: Jasur **is playing** tennis with his boss on Sunday morning.
sentences.translation: Jasur yakshanba ertalab boshlig'i bilan **tennis o'ynayapti**.

sentences.text: Jasur **is going to** start playing tennis again — he says he needs the exercise.
sentences.translation: Jasur yana tennis o'ynashni **boshlamoqchi** — jismoniy mashq kerakligini aytyapti.

sentences.text: Our team **is going to** lose — they're three goals down with five minutes left.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz **yutqazadi** — besh daqiqa qolganda uch gol orqada.

sentences.text: Madina **is having** a baby in April — she told us at dinner last night.
sentences.translation: Madina aprelda **farzand ko'ryapti** — kecha kechki ovqatda bizga aytdi.

examples.title: Dialogue: a friend's visit from London
examples.description: Toshkentlik do'st londonlik mehmon bilan rejalarni kelishadi: shaxsiy reja — Present Continuous, reys va poyezd jadvali — Present Simple.

sentences.text: — Hi Oliver! So when **are** you **arriving** in Tashkent?
sentences.translation: — Salom, Oliver! Xo'sh, Toshkentga **qachon kelyapsan**?

sentences.text: — On Thursday. My flight **lands** at 3 a.m., unfortunately.
sentences.translation: — Payshanba kuni. Afsuski, reysim tungi soat uchda **qo'nadi**.

sentences.text: — No problem, **I'm picking** you up at the airport.
sentences.translation: — Muammo yo'q, seni aeroportda **kutib olaman**.

sentences.text: — Are you sure? You**'re working** on Friday morning, aren't you?
sentences.translation: — Aminmisan? Juma kuni ertalab **ishlaysan**-ku, shundaymi?

sentences.text: — Yes, but **I'm not starting** until ten that day.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin o'sha kuni soat o'ngacha **ishga chiqmayman**.

sentences.text: — Great, thanks! And what **are** we **doing** at the weekend?
sentences.translation: — Zo'r, rahmat! Dam olish kunlari nima **qilyapmiz**?

sentences.text: — **We're going** to Samarkand on Saturday — the fast train **leaves** at eight.
sentences.translation: — Shanba kuni Samarqandga **boryapmiz** — tezyurar poyezd soat sakkizda **jo'naydi**.

sentences.text: — Brilliant! When **does** it **get** to Samarkand?
sentences.translation: — Ajoyib! U Samarqandga qachon **yetib boradi**?

sentences.text: — Just after ten. My cousin **is showing** us round the Registan.
sentences.translation: — O'ndan sal keyin. Amakivachcham bizga Registonni **ko'rsatib beryapti**.

sentences.text: — Perfect. I can't wait — **I'm bringing** my camera, of course!
sentences.translation: — A'lo. Sabrim chidamayapti — albatta, fotoapparatimni **olib kelaman**!

examples.title: Mixed: plans, timetables and news
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: kelishilgan reja (Present Continuous) va jadval, dastur (Present Simple) — kundalik hayot va yangiliklardan.

sentences.text: Parliament **meets** again on the 10th to discuss the new budget.
sentences.translation: Parlament yangi byudjetni muhokama qilish uchun 10-sanada yana **yig'iladi**.

sentences.text: **Are** you **doing** anything on Friday evening? There's a jazz concert in the park.
sentences.translation: Juma kuni kechqurun biror **rejangiz bormi**? Bog'da jaz konserti bor.

sentences.text: The sale **starts** tomorrow, so the shop **is opening** an hour earlier than usual.
sentences.translation: Chegirmalar ertaga **boshlanadi**, shuning uchun do'kon odatdagidan bir soat erta **ochilyapti**.

sentences.text: Aziz **isn't coming** to the office tomorrow; he**'s working** from home.
sentences.translation: Aziz ertaga ofisga **kelmayapti**, uydan **ishlaydi**.

sentences.text: What time **does** the conference **finish** on the last day?
sentences.translation: Konferensiya oxirgi kuni soat nechada **tugaydi**?

sentences.text: Kate and James **are getting** married in Oxford next spring, and we're invited!
sentences.translation: Keyt va Jeyms kelasi bahorda Oksfordda **turmush qurishyapti**, bizni ham taklif qilishdi!

sentences.text: Hurry — the film **begins** in five minutes, and we still haven't got our tickets.
sentences.translation: Shoshil — film besh daqiqadan keyin **boshlanadi**, biz esa hali chipta olmadik.

sentences.text: Next month the government **is introducing** new rules for electric scooters.
sentences.translation: Kelasi oy hukumat elektr samokatlar uchun yangi qoidalar **joriy qilyapti**.

sentences.text: I can't come to the gym tonight because **I'm babysitting** my nephew.
sentences.translation: Bugun kechqurun sport zaliga kela olmayman, chunki jiyanimga **qarab turaman**.

sentences.text: Dilnoza's plane **leaves** at six, so she**'s getting** up at three — poor thing!
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning samolyoti soat oltida **uchadi**, shuning uchun u soat uchda **turadi** — bechora!
